# David Gabeau — Full Profile

## Bio

I'm the founder and CEO of Tapestry, a permissionless social graph protocol for onchain applications, backed by USV, Redpoint, Slow, Fabric Ventures, Stellation, and Harlem Capital.

Zumi, an AI companion we built on Tapestry, has reached 160,000+ users.

Before Tapestry, I was an analyst at Union Square Ventures, focused on early-stage crypto, climate, and education companies.

Earlier, I dropped out of NYU, learned to code, and worked as an engineer at Snap and Lyft before each went public.

I write about technology trends and listen to Soulection weekly.

## Projects

### Tapestry
- URL: https://usetapestry.dev
- Description: Open social graph for the next generation of apps and agents. A permissionless protocol that lets any application read and write to a shared social graph on Solana without platform permission.
- Funding: Series A, backed by Union Square Ventures, Redpoint, Slow Ventures, Fabric Ventures, Stellation, and Harlem Capital
- Whitepaper: https://assets.usetapestry.dev/whitepaper.pdf
- Series A announcement: https://blog.usetapestry.dev/p/tapestry-series-a
- GitHub protocol: https://github.com/Primitives-xyz/primitives-protocol
- Solana starter kit: https://github.com/Primitives-xyz/solana-starter-kit

### Zumi
- URL: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zumi-chat-dress-up/id6751237911
- Description: Consumer app built around persistent AI companionship and long-term relationships. 160,000+ users.
- Built on the Tapestry social graph protocol
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/tag/zumichat
- Product Hunt: https://www.producthunt.com/products/zumigames

### Primitives
- URL: https://techcrunch.com/2022/05/25/primitives-crypto-wallet-social-network-snapchat-startup/
- Description: Platform for collecting digital art and building community around on-chain objects. 500,000+ NFTs minted.
- Predecessor company to Tapestry
- Art Basel Miami exhibit: https://solana.com/news/solana-creator-art-basel-miami-beach

### SSE
- URL: https://sse.gg
- Description: Trading platform for Solana memecoins and emerging tokens. $50M in volume.

### AI Atlas NYC
- URL: https://aiatlas.nyc
- Description: A nightly-rebuilt market map of New York's early-stage AI ecosystem. An agent pipeline scrapes funding announcements, LinkedIn signals, and founder activity, re-clusters the map, and publishes a new version each morning. Covers 50+ companies across 11 categories including Fintech & Trading AI, Agent Infrastructure, Health & Clinical AI, Enterprise GTM & RevOps AI, and AI-Native Consumer & Social.
- API: https://aiatlas.nyc/api/embed/atlas
- Built and maintained by David Gabeau
